newsitem.title: USA: CRA Managed files for 2 mln common shares.
newsitem.headline: CRA Managed files for 2 mln common shares.

text.p: CRA Managed Care Inc said Thursday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to two million common shares.
Of the total, 500,000 common shares will be sold by the company and 1.5 million will be sold by certain stockholders, the filing said.
After the offering, outstanding shares will total 9,407,532 common, the filing said.
The company will use the proceeds for repayment of short-term debt and general corporate purposes, including acquisitions, the filing said.
The company has granted the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option of up to 300,000 additional common shares, the filing said.
The offering will be made through Alex. Brown & Sons Inc, Dean Witter Reynolds Inc, Montgomery Securities and J.P. Morgan & Co.
Selling stockholders include some members of the board of directors, the filing said.
After the sale of stock, William Laverack, a director of the company since March 1994, will resign from his post.
CRA, of Boston, Mass., provides field case management and specialized cost containment services designed to reduce worker compensation costs.
